description: Take a screenshot of the app. Pass compareTo with a saved PNG path to view both screens. It first says what changed, measured: where, which element, and the exact colors before and now. Then the saved file, then the live screen. Leave query and nativeTag out for the whole screen. To crop a React Native view on an iOS Sim, pass query or nativeTag. The tool may scroll that view into sight. Use describe_screen to read text or find controls. Pictures use more tokens. Run the MCP on the device host.

baseline.description: Whole screen only: a name like "home". The first call saves the screen as that baseline (in .buoy/baselines); later calls compare against it and report what changed, with a diff picture.

compareTo.description: A saved PNG file to view next to this screen. Use a full path or a path from the project root. The file stays as it is.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

ignore.description: With baseline: leave these out of the comparison, by testID (e.g. ["live-map", "ad-banner"]), for parts that change on their own.

ignoreAreas.description: With baseline: areas to leave out, as fractions of the screen (0 to 1).

nativeTag.description: An exact nativeTag (from a previous call's candidates) to skip fuzzy matching.

query.description: Fuzzy match against testID, nativeID, accessibilityLabel, component name, or view type — e.g. "submit-button".

scrollIntoView.description: Attempt to scroll an off-screen component into view before capture. Default true; inspect the result.

serial.description: Android: the adb serial, when several devices are connected.

steady.description: With baseline: freeze the app's clock at the baseline's moment while capturing, so countdowns and times match (needs @buoy-gg/clock). Default true when the app has the clock tool.

threshold.description: With baseline: per-pixel color tolerance, 0 to 1. Default 0.1.

updateBaseline.description: With baseline: save the current screen as the new baseline instead of comparing.

name: screenshot_component
